# BuilderStack (dceniac.com)

> BuilderStack is an independent commercial evaluation directory of 22 verified open-source business software projects. Each review verifies 5 primary-source facts: commercial licensing rules (MIT, Apache-2.0, GPLv3, AGPLv3, Fair-code), active maintenance status, self-hosted server & RAM requirements, real total cost of ownership (TCO) vs SaaS per-seat pricing, and production pitfalls.

## Directory & Core Hubs

- [BuilderStack Home](https://dceniac.com/): Open-source business software you can actually run in production, verified with primary license texts and server requirements.
- [All Open-Source Projects Directory](https://dceniac.com/oss/): Filter 22 verified open-source software projects by use case, license type, and industry.

## Interactive Self-Hosting Cost & Sizing Calculators

- [Chatwoot Self-Hosted vs Cloud Seat Cost Calculator](https://dceniac.com/oss/chatwoot/): Compare Chatwoot Community Edition (MIT) vs Hacker/Business Cloud plans and Intercom/Zendesk per-agent pricing, plus Sidekiq/Postgres RAM sizing.
- [JupyterHub Classroom RAM, CPU & Cloud Cost Calculator](https://dceniac.com/oss/jupyterhub/): Estimate concurrent student notebook memory, CPU cores, and monthly VM costs for Littlest JupyterHub (TLJH) vs Kubernetes (Z2JH).
- [LiveKit WebRTC SFU Outbound Bandwidth & Egress Calculator](https://dceniac.com/oss/livekit/): Calculate N*(N-1) WebRTC video egress bandwidth (Mbps), monthly traffic transfer, and headless Chrome recording CPU requirements.

## Customer Support, CRM, ERP & Billing

- [Chatwoot](https://dceniac.com/oss/chatwoot/): Open-source omnichannel live chat and shared inbox (MIT license for Community Edition; Enterprise folder proprietary).
- [Zammad](https://dceniac.com/oss/zammad/): Open-source help desk and ticketing system (GNU AGPLv3, Elasticsearch RAM sizing, zero per-agent seat limits).
- [Odoo Community vs Enterprise](https://dceniac.com/oss/odoo/): Open-source ERP and MRP (LGPLv3 Community Edition vs proprietary Enterprise modules and accounting gaps).
- [Twenty CRM](https://dceniac.com/oss/twenty/): Modern open-source Salesforce/HubSpot alternative (GPLv3 with commercial exceptions, self-hosted Docker + Postgres + Redis).
- [Invoice Ninja](https://dceniac.com/oss/invoiceninja/): Client invoicing, quotes, and recurring billing portal (Elastic License 2.0 — free for internal business use, cannot resell as hosted SaaS).
- [n8n Workflow Automation](https://dceniac.com/oss/n8n/): Node-based workflow and AI automation (Sustainable Use License — free for internal business automation, restricted when embedding with customer credentials).

## E-Commerce, Headless Commerce, POS & Ordering

- [Medusa](https://dceniac.com/oss/medusa/): Composable headless commerce backend for Node.js developers (MIT license).
- [Saleor](https://dceniac.com/oss/saleor/): GraphQL-first headless e-commerce platform in Python/Django (BSD-3-Clause license).
- [WooCommerce](https://dceniac.com/oss/woocommerce/): WordPress-based online store platform (GPLv3, plugin renewal cost breakdown).
- [PrestaShop](https://dceniac.com/oss/prestashop/): Self-hosted PHP e-commerce storefront and back office (OSL-3.0 / AFL-3.0).
- [Bagisto](https://dceniac.com/oss/bagisto/): Laravel open-source e-commerce platform (MIT license).
- [Shopware Community Edition](https://dceniac.com/oss/shopware/): B2C/B2B e-commerce system (MIT license for shopware/shopware core).
- [Open Source Point of Sale (OSPOS)](https://dceniac.com/oss/opensourcepos/): Web-based retail POS with barcode scanning, inventory, and reporting (MIT license).
- [TastyIgniter](https://dceniac.com/oss/tastyigniter/): Restaurant online ordering and table reservation system (MIT license).

## Education, LMS, Live Video & AI Avatars

- [Moodle](https://dceniac.com/oss/moodle/): Full-featured open-source Learning Management System (GPLv3).
- [Canvas LMS](https://dceniac.com/oss/canvas-lms/): University and K-12 learning platform by Instructure (AGPLv3, high production server footprint).
- [Kolibri](https://dceniac.com/oss/kolibri/): Offline-first learning platform for low-bandwidth schools and training centers (MIT license).
- [JupyterHub](https://dceniac.com/oss/jupyterhub/): Multi-user Jupyter notebook server for coding classrooms and data teams (BSD-3-Clause).
- [BigBlueButton](https://dceniac.com/oss/bigbluebutton/): Virtual classroom web conferencing with whiteboard and breakout rooms (LGPLv3, dedicated bare-metal/VM sizing).
- [LiveKit](https://dceniac.com/oss/livekit/): WebRTC SFU media server and real-time voice/video AI agent infrastructure (Apache-2.0).
- [LiveTalking](https://dceniac.com/oss/livetalking/): Real-time interactive streaming digital human with lip-sync (Apache-2.0, GPU VRAM requirements).
- [OpenAvatarChat](https://dceniac.com/oss/openavatarchat/): Modular conversational digital human pipeline by HumanAIGC (Apache-2.0, single high-VRAM GPU deployment).
